title: E0088: Reflection-based injection
plain_english: Invoking the PHP Reflection API with user-controlled input can allow an attacker to instantiate classes, call methods, or access properties that should not be reachable.
why_matters: Reflection-based injection can: - Instantiate any autoloadable class - Call private or protected methods - Access sensitive object properties - Lead to object injection and remote code execution through gadget chains
